crossRefs.note: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

translations.web: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,
translations.bsb: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they returned with the report:
translations.kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
translations.asv: But the officers that came found them not in the prison; and they returned, and told,
